cases.name: reviews: the 100th valid review, deleted cards included
cases.note: 101 reviews one second apart from 09:00:00; r0051 has grade 5 (invalid), so the 100th valid one is r0101 at 09:01:40; half of them name c-vocab-999, a card that no longer exists, and still count. Hand check: 101 - 1 = 100.

cases.name: words-studied: distinct entries of live vocab cards in an existing deck
cases.note: Entries 1..10 are studied by the review of c-vocab-10 (deck d1 exists) at 09:14; entry 1 has two vocab cards (counted once), c-vocab-11 is in no existing deck, c-reverse-12 is not vocab, c-vocab-gone is deleted: none of them adds a word. Hand check: 1 (r0001) + 9 (entries 2..10) = 10 words.

cases.name: streak: a vacation day is neutral, the reached day is the run's third date
cases.note: Reviews on 11-02, 11-03 (twice), 11-04 (a vacation day: neutral, its review does not count) and 11-05. The run 11-02, 11-03, 11-05 reaches 3 on 11-05; reachedAt is that date's first review (06:30Z). Hand check: dailyStreak(...).best = 3 with now on 11-05.

cases.name: streak: a review after now (a fast device clock) is ignored
cases.note: Reviews on 11-02, 11-03 and 11-04 10:00Z, but now is 11-04 09:00Z: the third review is in the future and the run is 2 days. Nothing is reached.

cases.name: days-active: reviews, counted reads and string journal ids; vacation and numeric ids do not count
cases.note: Active: 11-02..11-07 (6 review days), 11-12 (a read of 45 s without bookId), 11-13 (journal J1), 11-16 (read 600 s), 11-18 (journal J2) = 10. Not active: 11-08 (vacation, though reviewed), 11-09 (read of 20 s), 11-10 (numeric entryId), 11-11 (empty entryId), 11-14 session, 11-15 view, 11-17 lookup. Reached at e0010; J1 also reaches journal-entries:1 (the journal is on, flashcards are off).

cases.name: reading-hours: clamped seconds sum, a read without bookId counts
cases.note: 20 s counts 0, 1800 s without bookId (a restored read of an unknown book) counts, "600" (a string) counts 0, then 1769 s and 30 s: 1800 + 1769 + 30 = 3599 s, one second short of the hour, so the hour is reached by e0006 on 11-03 (9000 s clamped to 7200; total 10799 s, under 5 h). Hand check: 3599 + 7200 = 10799.

cases.name: journal-entries: distinct string entry ids; numeric, missing or null payloads count for nothing
cases.note: J01 on 11-02 09:00 reaches 1; J01 again, entryId 7, {} and null add nothing; J02..J10 on 11-04..11-12 reach 10 with J10 on 11-12 09:00. The same event makes the 10th active date (11-02 and 11-04..11-12), so days-active:10 is reached with it. Hand check: 1 + 9 = 10 entries and 10 dates.

cases.name: a crossing right after a zone change takes the new zone's day
cases.note: History: UTC, then Asia/Tokyo from 2026-11-10T16:00:00Z. The first journal entry at 16:30Z is 01:30 on 11-11 in Tokyo, so reachedDay is 2026-11-11 (in UTC it would be 11-10).

cases.name: ties: two reviews at one instant, ordered by id
cases.note: 98 reviews, then r0099 and r0100 both at 10:00:00 (listed in the other order); by (ts, id) the 100th is r0100, and either way reachedAt is 10:00:00Z.

cases.name: words-mature: the 10th mature word; a later lapse keeps it; other cards never count
cases.note: c-vocab-e reaches review state with stability 25 on 11-02 + e days (e = 1..10), so the 10th is on 11-12 09:00; c-vocab-3 lapses on 11-22 (9 mature then) and the milestone stays reached. c-vocab-11 (no existing deck), c-reverse-12 (not vocab) and c-vocab-77 (deleted) are mature from 11-02 and never count.

cases.name: characters-learned: cells over variant forms, the 10th learned cell
cases.note: Nine one-glyph cards reach stability 200 (score 90) on 11-02..11-10; the cell 国 is learned through its variant 國 (card 中國, stability 5 = score 30 on 11-11, 200 = 90 on 11-12), the 10th cell, on 11-12 09:00. 学: a reverse card never counts; on 11-13 a writing card (365, score 100) and a vocab card (1, score 12) average 56, not learned. The ten vocab cards of the nine glyphs and 中國 also reach words-mature:10 at the same instant. Hand check: log2(201)/log2(366) = 0.898 -> 90.

cases.name: a non-Han language has no characters family
cases.note: Language ko: no character universe (chars null) and characters-learned is not enabled; the eleven mature vocab cards still reach words-mature:10 at 11-02 09:00 (all at one instant).

cases.name: level-complete: a word level when every member is mature, a character level when every cell is learned
cases.note: HSK 1 (501, 502, 503) is complete when 503 reaches stability 21 on 11-05 09:00; HSK 2 lacks a card for 511; HSK 3 has no members (never complete). Level 1 cells 木 (11-02), 林 (150 = score 85, 11-06) and 来/來 (through the variant 來, 11-07) complete on 11-07 09:00; Level 2 has 森 with no card.

cases.name: flashcards switched off: no review, word, streak, mature or level family; days-active still counts reviews
cases.note: 120 reviews over 11-02..11-13 and ten mature cards, but flashcards are off: reviews:100, words-studied:10, streak:3/7 and words-mature:10 are not computed. days-active (always on) counts the 12 review dates and reaches 10 on 11-11 (first review there, 09:00:09).
